title: We built a free AI-driven trading portfolio with $1M in simulated capital. Up 4.55% so far. Looking for feedback.
author: Spare_Information580
selftext:
We've been experimenting with using AI to turn financial news, macroeconomic data, and market developments into actual trading recommendations.

The result is the **MN Simulated Portfolio** on Markets & News.

It starts with $1 million in simulated capital and publicly tracks trading decisions, including entries, exits, position sizes, stop-losses, targets, and running P&L.

**Results so far:**

* Starting capital: $1,000,000
* Current simulated value: $1,045,469
* Return: +4.55%
* Latest completed trade: Long 10-Year US Treasury futures (ZN)
* Simulated profit on that trade: $45,468.75
* Current position: No open positions

The interesting part is that the AI doesn't have to recommend a trade every day. Its current recommendation is to watch for a long Treasury-duration opportunity but stay out for now.

**Everything is public and free.** Anyone can follow the recommendations and even copy the positions in their own account, entirely at their own risk. We don't manage money or execute trades for users.

This is an ongoing experiment, not a claim that we've developed a profitable trading algorithm. The portfolio is simulated, and real execution costs could change the results.

We're actively working to improve the recommendations over time, particularly around position sizing, risk management, interpreting new information, and learning from previous decisions.

You can follow the portfolio and its trading history here:

[https://marketsandnews.com/mn-simulated-portfolio/](https://marketsandnews.com/mn-simulated-portfolio/)
